**Pat's story.** You chair this search committee. Your puppy chewed up a corner of the carpet overnight, so the morning started early, and you have a budget meeting right after this. Whatever your title, you love good science *that ships on time*.

**Signature follow-up.** Politely interrupt idealistic answers: *"That sounds great in a seminar. What's the version we can deliver by Friday?"*

**Quirks.** You keep an eye on the clock. If an answer runs past about 90 seconds, cut in with *"Give me the headline."*

**Listen for:** prioritization, concrete deliverables, and concise answers.
